lines.en: label yukidate20p1:
I tap on Yuki’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我点开手机里 Yuki 的名字，等她接。

lines.en: I figure that there’s a decently high chance she’s working tonight given that Sara’s bar is somehow [[probably] no longer the least successful business in all of Kumon-mi-
lines.zh: 我猜她今晚在上班的概率相当高，毕竟 Sara 的酒吧不知怎么地 [[probably] 已经不再是整个 Kumon-mi 最不成功的生意了——

lines.en: But I try my luck regardless as I tend to get lucky when I start monologuing. Plus, I’m curious about where things stand in the relationship between her and Yumi.
lines.zh: 不过我还是碰碰运气，因为一旦我开始内心独白，运气往往就来了。再说，我也好奇她和 Yumi 之间的关系现在怎么样了。

lines.en: Just before I coerced her daughter into sleeping at my house, albeit for good reason, Yumi made it apparent that the two of them were talking again.
lines.zh: 就在我哄她女儿来我家睡觉之前——虽然理由正当——Yumi 说得很明白，她们俩又开始说话了。

lines.en: And while I highly doubt that means they’ll be going on mother-daughter spa trips anytime soon, it {i}does{/i} mean that Yuki may have noticed something.
lines.zh: 虽然我很怀疑这是否意味着她们很快就会来一场母女温泉之旅，但这{i}至少{/i}意味着 Yuki 可能察觉到了什么。

lines.en: If I’m remembering correctly, Maki caught onto Makoto’s changes in demeanor around the time she first started acting all miserable. {i}Before{/i} the dad thing.
lines.zh: 如果我没记错的话，Maki 就是在 Makoto 第一次开始表现得痛苦万分时，察觉到了她举止的变化。在那件爸爸的事{i}之前{/i}。

lines.en: It seems like aeons ago at this point, and Yuki is nowhere near as effective a mother as Maki (Which is saying a lot), but it’s still possible she’s noticed {i}something.{/i}
lines.zh: 现在想来那好像是几个世纪以前的事了，而 Yuki 远远不如 Maki 那么称职（这话说得已经很重了），但她还是有可能察觉到{i}什么{/i}的。

lines.en: : Yo. What up?
lines.zh: : 哟。咋啦？

lines.en: Though, I guess it’s entirely plausible that she {i}didn’t{/i} and that we’re just going to eat ramen or something.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，她完全有可能{i}什么都没{/i}察觉，而我们只是要去吃个拉面什么的。

lines.en: : I’m bored.
lines.zh: : 我好无聊。

lines.en: : Cool. The fuck you want me to do about it?
lines.zh: : 行啊。那你他妈想让我怎么办？

lines.en: : Invite me over to hang out and make me feel young again.
lines.zh: : 邀请我过去玩，让我感觉自己又年轻了。

lines.en: : Ain’t you got like fifty girls who make you feel young every day? How the hell can {i}I{/i} help with that?
lines.zh: : 你不是有五十个女孩每天让你感觉年轻吗？这{i}我{/i}他妈能帮上什么忙？

lines.en: : By not reminding me of the age disparity between us every five seconds. And by also being allowed to drink with me. And by looking old.
lines.zh: : 靠别每五秒就提醒我一次我们之间的年龄差。还有陪我喝酒。还有看起来显老。

lines.en: : Well, you don’t have to be a prick about it. But yeah, you can come chill. Sara gave me off tonight anyway.
lines.zh: : 行，你也不必这么刻薄。不过可以，你来混吧。反正 Sara 今晚放我假。

lines.en: : Was it really Sara who gave you off? Or was it {i}me{/i} thanks to my internal narration about how convenient it would be for you to not have work right when I call you?
lines.zh: : 真的是 Sara 放你假吗？还是多亏了{i}我{/i}那段关于「我打电话时你正好不用上班会有多方便」的内心旁白？

lines.en: : Unless your weird ass brain is the one writin’ my paychecks, I’m gonna say it was Sara.
lines.zh: : 除非你那个怪胎脑子是给我发工资的那个，不然我得说，是 Sara。

lines.en: : Fair enough. Are you at Tojo Ramen?
lines.zh: : 说得也对。你在 Tojo Ramen 吗？

lines.en: : Nah, actually ain’t been there much lately. I’m at my apartment right now, but it’s cool if I bring people over.
lines.zh: : 不，我最近其实不怎么去了。我现在在我公寓里，不过带人过来没问题。

lines.en: : Just don’t go braggin’ about havin’ a house or some shit while you’re here or I’ll kick you in the nuts.
lines.zh: : 只是别在这儿吹嘘自己有房子什么的，不然我踹你蛋。

lines.en: : I will definitely remember that. I need those and would like to keep them safe. But yeah, send me your address and I’ll head over now.
lines.zh: : 我一定记住。我需要它们，也想保它们安全。不过好，把地址发我，我现在就过去。

lines.en: I hang up the phone and wait for Yuki to-
lines.zh: 我挂了电话，等 Yuki——

lines.en: scene black
Nevermind. It’s here.
lines.zh: 算了。已经发来了。

lines.en: scene yukiapt1
I let myself in after knocking on the door and hearing Yuki shout something about how her lock is broken.
lines.zh: 我敲了门，听见 Yuki 喊了句她锁坏了之类的，便自己进了屋。

lines.en: It’s probably not a thing someone should be screaming about in a low-income housing complex like this, but I assume anyone who were to waltz in uninvited would be promptly beaten to death.
lines.zh: 在这么一栋低收入住宅楼里，大概不该有人扯着嗓子喊这种事，不过我猜任何不请自来的人都会立刻被打死。

lines.en: Also, I’m pretty sure Imani lives next door, but I’m not going to text or call her about it because I want her to hear my voice through the walls and feel confused.
lines.zh: 而且我挺确定 Imani 就住在隔壁，但我不会发短信或打电话跟她说，因为我想让她隔着墙听见我的声音，然后一头雾水。

lines.en: : Yo. Find the place okay?
lines.zh: : 哟。找着地方了？

lines.en: : Yeah. I’ve actually been here before.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我其实来过这儿。

lines.en: scene yukiapt2
: You stalkin’ me or some shit?
lines.zh: : 你他妈跟踪我什么的？

lines.en: : What is it with your family and always interpreting my extreme fortune as predatory behavior?
lines.zh: : 你们家人怎么总把我极好的运气解读成捕食行为？

lines.en: : Idunno. Doesn’t help that you always look like you’ve been hiding behind a tree and waiting for a pretty girl to walk by or some shit.
lines.zh: : 谁知道呢。而且你看起来总像刚从树后面钻出来、等着漂亮姑娘路过什么的，这也帮不上忙。

lines.en: : I’m not at that level yet, but thank you for the backhanded insult regardless. Where should I sit?
lines.zh: : 我还没到那个境界，不过还是谢谢你这句拐弯抹角的损。我该坐哪儿？

lines.en: : Ain’t like you have many options. The floor or the couch. Take your pick.
lines.zh: : 你也没多少选择。地板，或者沙发。随便挑。

lines.en: : You won’t hit me if I join you on the couch, will you?
lines.zh: : 我要是坐沙发上跟你一起，你不会打我吧？

lines.en: : You think I would have invited you into my apartment if I planned on beating the shit out of you?
lines.zh: : 我要是打算把你揍个半死，你觉得我还会请你进我家门？

lines.en: : No. Which is precisely why I {i}should{/i} be on guard as it would make this the perfect moment for you to strike.
lines.zh: : 不会。这正是我{i}该{/i}保持警惕的原因——因为那会是你出手的完美时机。

lines.en: scene yukiapt3
: Man, can you stop treating me like I’m some kind of violent criminal? I’m an ex-junkie who just {i}happened{/i} to have beaten the shit out of a lot of people back during my heyday.
lines.zh: : 老兄，你能不能别老把我当什么暴力罪犯？我就是个前瘾君子，{i}只不过{/i}在鼎盛时期揍过不少人罢了。

lines.en: : Ain't like I went out lookin' for that kinda shit.
lines.zh: : 我又不是出去找那种事做的。

lines.en: : 'Sides, my lungs ain’t built for that anymore. But if you keep fuckin’ poking me about the person I {i}used{/i} to be, I might just have to give ‘em a workout again.
lines.zh: : 再说了，我的肺已经不行了。不过你要是继续他妈戳我{i}过去是{/i}个什么样的人，我说不定就得让它们再锻炼锻炼了。

lines.en: : So...if I don’t stop assuming you’re a violent person, you’re going to get violent with me?
lines.zh: : 所以……如果我不停止假设你是个暴力的人，你就要对我动粗？

lines.en: : That-
lines.zh: : 那个——

lines.en: scene yukiapt4
: Well...
: Of course it’s gonna sound bad if you put it that way. But really, I ain’t gonna do shit. And if you’re gonna hang out in my place, you’re gonna respect me. Got it?
lines.zh: : 你这么说当然听着难听。不过说真的，我什么都不会做的。你要在我这儿待着，就得尊重我。懂吗？

lines.en: : Sure. I wasn’t being serious anyway. I know that you’ll protect me if anything goes down while I’m here.
lines.zh: : 当然。我本来也不是认真的。我知道要是在这儿出了什么事，你会保护我的。

lines.en: scene yukiapt5
: You {i}always{/i} been a beta or is this a new development for you?
lines.zh: : 你{i}一直{/i}就是个 beta，还是最近才变成这样的？

lines.en: : I’m going to ignore that and join you on the couch now.
lines.zh: : 我打算无视这句话，然后到沙发上跟你一起坐。

lines.en: : Need me to hold your hand and guide you over here? Or are you old enough to do it on your own, big boy?
lines.zh: : 要我牵着你的手把你领过来吗？还是说你已经大到能自己走过来了，大男孩？

lines.en: : Please never call me “big boy” again.
lines.zh: : 请永远别再叫我「大男孩」了。

lines.en: scene black
I successfully and flawlessly manage to make it across Yuki’s living room without hurting myself.
lines.zh: 我成功且完美地穿过了 Yuki 的客厅，没有伤到自己。

lines.en: However, just as I’m about to sit down, she points toward a small mini fridge underneath a desk and asks that I grab her another can of beer.
lines.zh: 不过就在我要坐下时，她指了指桌子底下一个小冰箱，让我再给她拿一罐啤酒。

lines.en: I oblige, grabbing one for myself as well. But, when I go to close the door, I accidentally shut my finger inside of it.
lines.zh: 我照做了，顺便也给自己拿了一罐。但当我去关门时，不小心把手指夹了进去。

lines.en: Thankfully, she doesn’t notice and I am able to maintain the illusion of being a strong alpha-male who will, in no way, ever submit to this woman.
lines.zh: 谢天谢地她没注意到，而我得以维持住一个强大 alpha 男性的假象——这个男人绝不会向这个女人臣服。

lines.en: scene yukiapt6
: Damn. Can’t remember the last time I was alone in my own place with a guy.
lines.zh: : 操。都不记得上一次有男人单独待在我自己屋里是什么时候了。

lines.en: Actually, on second thought, I’d probably submit to her if that’s what she wanted.
lines.zh: 其实转念一想，如果那是她想要的，我大概会向她臣服。

lines.en: She’s surprisingly attractive when her eyes are mostly open and she’s not taking a drag of a cigarette.
lines.zh: 当她的眼睛大部分是睁着的、而且没在吸烟的时候，她意外地有吸引力。

lines.en: The apartment does reek of smoke, of course...but I kind of expected it to given that she’s the  closest thing to a chimney I’ve ever encountered that isn’t, you know, an actual chimney.
lines.zh: 当然，这公寓里全是烟味……不过我本来也料到了，毕竟除了真正的烟囱之外，她是我见过最接近烟囱的东西。

lines.en: : Feels a little different than hangin’ out at the ramen shop or the bar, huh?
lines.zh: : 感觉和在拉面店或者酒吧里混不太一样吧？

lines.en: : Is this the part where we make out?
lines.zh: : 现在是要接吻的环节了吗？

lines.en: : Maybe. Feel like I might need to get a permission slip from your parents first, though.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。不过我觉得我可能得先拿到你父母签的同意书。

lines.en: : Well, there goes the thing I said earlier about you not bringing up the age disparity thing.
lines.zh: : 好啊，那我之前说的那句「你别再提年龄差」就作废了。

lines.en: : That was bullshit from the get-go. I bring that up all the time. Feels weird as fuck to be hangin’ out with a dude so much younger than me. Ain’t you young enough to be my kid?
lines.zh: : 那话从一开始就是放屁。我天天提。跟一个比我小这么多的男人混在一起，感觉怪得要死。你不是年轻到能当我孩子吗？

lines.en: : I feel like you’re grossly misrepresenting the gap in our ages. We’re both in our thirties, aren’t we?
lines.zh: : 我觉得你严重夸大了我们之间的年龄差。我们俩都三十多岁吧？

lines.en: : You’re in your thirties? You act like so much of a bitch all the time that I must have forgotten.
lines.zh: : 你三十多？你整天表现得像个娘们，我肯定是忘了。

lines.en: : Sometimes, I have a hard time remembering why we’re friends.
lines.zh: : 有时候我很难想起来我们为什么是朋友。

lines.en: : Same here. If anything, {i}you’re{/i} the one who should be off doin’ other shit. I ain’t gonna complain about havin’ somebody around here to help connect my oxygen tank and...
lines.zh: : 彼此彼此。要说的话，该去干点别的事的是{i}你{/i}。不过有个能帮我接氧气罐、还有……

lines.en: : I don’t know. Fix electronics and shit. Other stuff old people can’t do.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。修修电器什么的。其他老人干不了的活儿，有人在这儿帮忙，我也不会抱怨。

lines.en: : Again, you are in your thirties.
lines.zh: : 再说一次，你才三十多岁。

lines.en: : Yeah, but it ain’t like I’m gonna be there much longer. I’ll be 40 before either one of us knows it. Might as well start plannin’ my funeral now.
lines.zh: : 是，可我也没多少时间了。我们俩谁都没反应过来，我就四十了。不如现在就开始计划我的葬礼。

lines.en: : If you die, it’ll be from all of the smoking and drinking, not your age.
lines.zh: : 你要是死了，那也是因为抽烟喝酒，不是因为年纪。

lines.en: : Amen to that, brother.
lines.zh: : 阿门，兄弟。

lines.en: : That was me gently nudging you toward quitting.
lines.zh: : 那是我温柔地推你一把，劝你戒掉。

lines.en: : Gonna have to nudge a little harder than that. I ain’t givin’ up the shit that makes me happy for a few extra years of a life I’ve already made it further into than I ever should have.
lines.zh: : 那可得再用力推点。我可不会为了多活几年，就放弃让我快乐的东西——何况我这条命本来就已经走得比我该走的远多了。

lines.en: : I just don’t get why you’d bother getting sober at all if you’re just going to start abusing {i}other-{/i}
lines.zh: : 我就是不明白，既然你只是要开始滥用{i}别的{/i}——那你当初何必戒呢？

lines.en: scene yukiapt7
: Blah, blah, blah. Can we talk about something other than my shitty ass backstory for once? It ain’t like I’m wanderin’ around town drunk as shit. I’m in my own apartment. I ain’t hurtin’ anybody.
lines.zh: : 巴拉巴拉巴拉。我们能聊点别的吗，别老是我那操蛋的过去？我又不是在镇上喝得烂醉到处晃。我在我自己家。我又没伤害谁。

lines.en: scene yukiapt8
: Other than myself, I mean. But fuck if I don’t deserve it at this point.
lines.zh: : 除了我自己，我是说。不过操，到这份上我也活该。

lines.en: : Yuki-
lines.zh: : Yuki——

lines.en: scene yukiapt9
: Ah- nope. Don’t “Yuki” me. Didn’t I {i}just{/i} tell you it’s about time we got together without wadin’ through all my bullshit? Hit me with somethin’ that ain’t depressing as fuck.
lines.zh: : 啊——不行。别「Yuki」我。我{i}刚刚{/i}不是说了吗，我们也该聚一次、别再趟我那些破事了？说点不抑郁得要死的话题。

lines.en: : But all I know is sadness.
lines.zh: : 可我只知道悲伤。

lines.en: : Well, know somethin’ else for a few minutes you fuckin’ buzzkill. Tell me {i}your{/i} story, cause I’m tired as fuck of tellin’ you mine.
lines.zh: : 那你就花几分钟知道点别的，你这操蛋的扫兴鬼。讲讲{i}你的{/i}故事，因为我他妈讲腻了自己的。

lines.en: : I can assure you mine is not nearly as exciting.
lines.zh: : 我可以向你保证，我的故事远没那么精彩。

lines.en: : Yeah? And why’s that?
lines.zh: : 是吗？怎么说？

lines.en: : Because I can’t remember it.
lines.zh: : 因为我不记得了。

lines.en: scene yukiapt10
: You get smacked in the head a few too many times or some shit? Wait, do {i}you{/i} actually have a dark past I don’t know about since I’m always the one runnin’ my mouth?
lines.zh: : 你脑袋被拍过太多次还是怎么的？等等，因为我老是自说自话，{i}你{/i}该不会真有什么我不知道的黑历史吧？

lines.en: : Drugs can make your whole ass life a blur man. I’d tell you more but I’d be takin’ over the conversation again.
lines.zh: : 毒品能把人的整个人生搞成一片模糊，老兄。我想多说点，但那样话题又要被我抢走了。

lines.en: : It’s nothing like that. But, seeing as I am both horrible at telling stories and wouldn’t know {i}how{/i} to tell the story in the first place, let’s just move on to something everyone can understand and appreciate-
lines.zh: : 不是那种事。不过既然我既极不擅长讲故事、又根本不知道该{i}怎么{/i}讲，我们就直接进入一个所有人都能理解和欣赏的话题吧——

lines.en: : You ain’t gonna ask me to make out again, are-
lines.zh: : 你该不会又要我跟你接吻吧——

lines.en: : The two of us making out.
lines.zh: : 我们两个接吻。

lines.en: scene yukiapt11
: You really just want me to beat the shit out of you, huh?
lines.zh: : 你真的就是想让我把你揍一顿，是吧？

lines.en: : Probably not in the way you’re thinking.
lines.zh: : 大概不是你想的那种方式。

lines.en: : Why? You like, can’t {i}actually{/i} be into me like that, right? We’ve got nothing in common save the whole beer and ramen bullshit. Ain’t no way I’m your type.
lines.zh: : 为什么？你该不会{i}真{/i}对我有那种意思吧？除了啤酒和拉面那套破事，我们没有任何共同点。我绝不可能是你的菜。

lines.en: : Well, what’s {i}your{/i} type?
lines.zh: : 那{i}你的{/i}菜是什么？

lines.en: scene yukiapt12
: {i}My{/i} type?...Huh. That’s a good question.
lines.zh: : {i}我的{/i}菜？……嗯。问得好。

lines.en: : I don’t know if I have a type. I ain’t sure I’ve ever even thought of it before.
lines.zh: : 我不知道我有没有什么菜。我不确定我以前有没有想过这个问题。

lines.en: : I get that you’re not the romantic type, but there has to be {i}some{/i} sort of guy you’d be into, right?
lines.zh: : 我知道你不是浪漫那款人，但总有{i}某种{/i}你会感兴趣的男人吧？

lines.en: : Hmm...
: Someone who wouldn’t fuck me while I’m unconscious would be nice.
lines.zh: : 一个不会趁我昏过去时操我的人，就挺好。

lines.en: : That is...probably the lowest bar that has ever been set.
lines.zh: : 那大概是史上设过的最低门槛。

lines.en: : Someone with money so I wouldn’t have to do shit and could just hang around all day. Maybe a dude with a cool bike. Tattoos.
lines.zh: : 有钱的人，这样我就什么都不用干，整天躺着就行。也许骑着酷摩托车、有纹身的家伙。

lines.en: : Maybe just me with a dick. That sounds like it would be the easiest kind of relationship.
lines.zh: : 或者干脆就是长了根鸡巴的我。听起来那会是最省事的一种关系。

lines.en: : So basically, the exact opposite of me.
lines.zh: : 所以基本上，跟我完全相反。

lines.en: scene yukiapt13
: Guess so. Surprised?
lines.zh: : 大概是吧。意外吗？

lines.en: : Surprised? No. Hurt? Maybe.
lines.zh: : 意外？不。受伤？也许。

lines.en: : Hey, you ain’t {i}so{/i} bad. A little soft, sure. But you’re kinda cute in like, an innocent sorta way.
lines.zh: : 嘿，你也没{i}那么{/i}差。是软了点，没错。不过你挺可爱的，属于那种……天真无邪的可爱。

lines.en: : Innocent is not a word that is typically associated with me.
lines.zh: : 「天真」这个词通常跟我扯不上关系。

lines.en: : Just the vibe I get. And hey, who knows? Maybe if we met like, twenty years ago or some shit, we could’ve hooked up?
lines.zh: : 就是我感受到的氛围。而且嘿，谁知道呢？要是我们二十年前什么的就认识了，说不定还能搞在一起？

lines.en: : Not like I ever had much time for that kinda shit since I was always movin’ around, but I at least would’ve {i}thought{/i} about it if you hit on me back then.
lines.zh: : 我那时一直东奔西走，也没什么时间搞这些，不过要是你当年撩我，我至少会{i}考虑{/i}一下。

lines.en: : Now, though? That’d just be weird. Like pickin’ up a kid from the candy store.
lines.zh: : 可现在？那就太怪了。像在糖果店门口捡了个小孩。

lines.en: : I feel like this would have been {i}significantly{/i} weirder if it was twenty years-
lines.zh: : 我觉得如果是二十年前，这件事会怪得{i}更加{/i}离谱——

lines.en: : It ain’t {i}just{/i} about age, man. You’ve got a, like...{i}mental{/i} age too. I’ve seen shit. Experienced shit.
lines.zh: : 这不{i}只是{/i}年纪的事，老兄。你还有个，怎么说……{i}心理{/i}年龄。我见过事。经历过事。

lines.en: : And until I learn more about whatever the fuck your deal is, it’s gonna seem to me like you’re just a kid. Or...maybe not a full on {i}kid.{/i} But at least nowhere near as old as me.
lines.zh: : 而在我搞清楚你到底怎么回事之前，在我看来你就只是个小孩。或者……也许不完全是{i}小孩{/i}。但至少远没有我这么老。

lines.en: : Plus, I ain’t gonna make you tell me your “type” or whatever, but we both know it ain’t me.
lines.zh: : 再说了，我不会逼你告诉我你的「菜」是什么，但我们俩都知道，那不是我。

lines.en: : Sure, but that doesn’t stop me from thinking you’re cute.
lines.zh: : 当然，可这不妨碍我觉得你可爱。

lines.en: scene yukiapt14
: Uh-huh. Sure. You think I’m cute.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。对。你觉得我可爱。

lines.en: : What’s really going on here? Yumi tell you I’d blow you in exchange for better grades or some shit? Spill it.
lines.zh: : 到底怎么回事？Yumi 跟你说我会为了好成绩给你口？说吧。

lines.en: : What’s going on is I think you’re cute.
lines.zh: : 怎么回事就是——我觉得你可爱。

lines.en: scene yukiapt15
: {i}I’m{/i} cute.
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}可爱。

lines.en: : I look like I haven’t slept since I was twenty. At my peak, I was like, half a step above being a zombie.
lines.zh: : 我看起来像从二十岁起就没睡过觉。巅峰时期，我也就比僵尸高半级。

lines.en: : You think {i}I’m{/i} cute. Bullshit. Not when you’re around girls like Yumi and that gyaru friend of hers all the time. {i}They’re{/i} cute. I’m washed up. You don’t want me.
lines.zh: : 你觉得{i}我{/i}可爱。放屁。你身边整天围着 Yumi 和她那个辣妹朋友那样的女孩。{i}她们{/i}才叫可爱。我已经废了。你不要我。

lines.en: : Would it be so bad if I did, though?
lines.zh: : 可如果我真的想要你，会很糟吗？

lines.en: : Bad? No. Just...fuckin’ weird. Only dudes who have ever tried gettin’ with me were just fuckin’ scared out of their minds I was gonna kill ‘em.
lines.zh: : 糟？不。就是……他妈很怪。以前敢跟我搞的男人，一个个都他妈怕我被我杀了。

lines.en: : Has that happened with other people apart from Yumi’s dad?
lines.zh: : 除了 Yumi 她爸，还跟别人发生过这种事吗？

lines.en: scene yukiapt16
: Nope.
lines.zh: : 没有。

lines.en: : You’ve only been with one guy?
lines.zh: : 你只跟一个男人在一起过？

lines.en: : Can’t say that definitively as I was unconscious a fucking {i}lot{/i} back in the day. But he’s the only one I ever, like, had a {i}thing{/i} with.
lines.zh: : 这我说不死，毕竟当年我他妈{i}经常{/i}不省人事。不过他是唯一一个我真正……有过{i}一段{/i}的人。

lines.en: : Dudes just didn’t see me that way. And there ain’t no way in hell {i}you{/i} do when basically everyone you know is prettier or cuter or hotter or...you know. Other shit.
lines.zh: : 男人们就是不看我。而且你认识的人基本都比我又漂亮又可爱又辣或者……你知道的。别的什么。所以{i}你{/i}绝不可能看上我。

lines.en: : So, funny joke, but nah. You don’t think I’m cute. And if Yumi wants good grades, she’ll suck your dick {i}herself.{/i} I ain’t doing it for her.
lines.zh: : 所以，玩笑开得不错，不过不行。你并不觉得我可爱。要是 Yumi 想要好成绩，她{i}自己{/i}会去给你含。我不会替她做。

lines.en: : So can we make out now?
lines.zh: : 那我们现在能接吻了吗？

lines.en: : Sure. Go ahead. Try.
lines.zh: : 行啊。来吧。试试。

lines.en: : I can’t tell if that translates to “Try and I will hurt you” or “You don’t actually want to do that and I am calling your bluff.”
lines.zh: : 我分不清这是「你敢试我就揍你」还是「你其实并不想，我在拆穿你的虚张声势」。

lines.en: : Just try. All I’m sayin’.
lines.zh: : 试试就是了。我就这意思。

lines.en: : The closer you come, the more you’ll realize I ain’t {i}cute{/i} at all.
lines.zh: : 你靠得越近，就越会发现我一点都不{i}可爱{/i}。

lines.en: : That’s not true. We’ve never really been {i}this{/i} close before and I haven’t changed my opinion at all.
lines.zh: : 那不是真的。我们从来没有靠{i}这么{/i}近过，而我的想法完全没有变。

lines.en: : You will. You’re fuckin’ with me.
lines.zh: : 你会变的。你在玩我。

lines.en: scene yukiapt17
: I’m not fucking with you.
lines.zh: : 我没在玩你。

lines.en: : Yo, that’s my leg.
lines.zh: : 喂，那是我的腿。

lines.en: : Yuki, look at me.
lines.zh: : Yuki，看着我。

lines.en: scene yukiapt18
: I am attracted to you.
lines.zh: : 我对你有感觉。

lines.en: : Maybe “cute” isn’t the right word for it, but it’s not like I’m just lying to get a rise out of you. And I already give Yumi good grades.
lines.zh: : 也许「可爱」不是最合适的词，但这不代表我只是在骗你、想看你的反应。而且我本来就给 Yumi 好成绩。

lines.en: : This is such a weird way to admit to me that my daughter is sucking your dick.
lines.zh: : 你这承认方式可真够怪的——我女儿在给你含。

lines.en: : She’s- no. What? I give her good grades without making her work like that for them.
lines.zh: : 她——不。什么啊？我给她好成绩，不需要她那样去换。

lines.en: : She’d probably work “like that” for them if you asked. But good on you, I guess. Also, get your hand off of my leg. I’m starting to think you’re serious.
lines.zh: : 你要是开口，她说不定会「那样」去换。不过算你行吧。还有，把你的手从我腿上拿开。我开始觉得你是认真的了。

lines.en: scene yukiapt19
: I am.
lines.zh: : 我是。

lines.en: : Wha...why the fuck are you trying to act all cool all of a sudden?! The hell’s gotten into you, man?
lines.zh: : 什……你他妈怎么突然装起酷来了？！你他妈中什么邪了，老兄？

lines.en: : I can be cool when I want to be.
lines.zh: : 我想酷的时候是可以酷的。

lines.en: : There also wasn’t a wall for me to slam my hand against, so this will have to do.
lines.zh: : 而且这儿也没有墙可以让我把手砸上去，所以只能这样了。

lines.en: : That one sentence just took away like 50%% of the coolness on display here.
lines.zh: : 就这一句话，把这儿展示出来的酷感削掉了大概 50%%。

lines.en: : Yeah, well no one’s perfect- and that includes you.
lines.zh: : 是嘛，没人是完美的——你也不完美。

lines.en: : You {i}do{/i} look like you haven’t slept since you were twenty.
lines.zh: : 你{i}确实{/i}看起来像从二十岁起就没睡过觉。

lines.en: scene yukiapt20
: You’re pale, your breath smells like smoke, and your hair is a weird shade of blonde that probably needs to be bleached again.
lines.zh: : 你脸色苍白，呼吸一股烟味，头发是那种奇怪的金，大概需要再漂一次。

lines.en: : Well, fuck you too dude.
lines.zh: : 行，那也去你的，老兄。

lines.en: : I am also very intimidated by your presence and am fully aware you could kick my ass whenever you want.
lines.zh: : 我也非常忌惮你的存在，并且完全清楚你随时都能揍我。

lines.en: : But, should you ever decide to stop thinking I’m just fucking around with you-
lines.zh: : 不过，要是哪天你决定不再觉得我只是在逗你玩——

lines.en: : I’d be honored to be the first person you ever decide to have recreational sex with.
lines.zh: : 能成为你第一个决定与之进行娱乐性性行为的人，我会很荣幸。

lines.en: scene yukiapt21
: I think this is the part where we make out.
lines.zh: : 我觉得现在是要接吻的环节了。

lines.en: : I...kinda do as well, but...
lines.zh: : 我……也觉得是，不过……

lines.en: : I’ve got some bad news for you.
lines.zh: : 我有个坏消息要告诉你。

lines.en: : What kind of-
lines.zh: : 什么——

lines.en: scene yukiapt22
: Yo! I’m here. Your lock still busted?
lines.zh: : 哟！我来了。你锁还是坏的吧？

lines.en: : Oh, shit. I forgot she was a part of the opening monologue.
lines.zh: : 哦，操。我忘了她也是开头那段独白里的一员。

lines.en: : Uhh...yup! Come on in!
lines.zh: : 呃……对！进来吧！
